fields.gap: The thermal balance averages sky (260 to 275 K) and ground radiation and gives a no-convection bound of 313.5 K, under the QUESTIONABLE H35 service limit 343 to 353 K; but a hot apron, heat island, or hangar radiates from the ground side and is not bounded here.
fields.direction: Re-run the balance for named ground conditions (asphalt apron, hangar wall); measure emissivity of the actual face finish.
fields.effect: The core-limit conclusion could invert on a hot-ground site.
